title: The God of Abraham Praise
lyrics: The [Em]God of Abraham praise, Who [Am]reigns enthroned [Em]above;
I [Em]bow and bless the sacred [Am]name [Em]Forever blessed.
The [Em]God of Abraham praise, At [Am]whose supreme [Em]command
From [Em]earth I [G]rise, and seek the [C]joys At [G]His [D7]right [G]hand;
I [Em]all on earth [Am]forsake, Its [Em]wisdom, fame and [B7]power;
The [Em]whole triumphant host Give [Am]thanks to God on [Em]high;
Hail, [Em]Abraham's God and [Am]mine! I [Em]join the heavenly [B7]lays;
All [Em]might and majesty are [Am]Thine, And [Em]endless praise.
